collection.title: Audi A4 Cabrio 2004 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Audi A4 Cabrio 2004 to 2009 model requires a 22" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Slider Fit arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
